title: Retrospective analysis of real-world data on Herodikos Plus and OrthoHeroBKK.
summary:
Background

Many people experience pain or limitations affecting the back, knee, or neck. Digital exercise programmes may help reduce pain and improve movement in everyday life. However, there is still limited knowledge about how these programmes are used under routine care conditions and what changes occur during participation.

Research question

The study examines whether pain and physical limitations change over twelve weeks in adult patients using Herodikos Plus or OrthoHeroBKK. It also examines how regularly the programmes are used and how many patients continue until the end of the twelve-week period.

Methods

The study analyses data that have already been collected during routine care. No additional examinations, interviews, or treatments will be carried out. Adults with back, knee, or neck complaints will be included. The analysis will focus mainly on pain, physical functioning, and programme use at the start and after twelve weeks. The two programmes will be analysed separately and will not be directly compared.
conditions: All health conditions that may be treated within the two care programmes will be included.  For OrthoHeroBKK, this includes the following ICD-10 codes: M54.2, M54.3, M54.4, M54.5, M54.6, M25.26, M25.36, M25.66, M25.56, M17.0 to M17.9, M22.0, M22.1, M22.2, M22.3, M22.4, M23.2, M23.33, M23.5, M23.6, M23.8, and M23.9.  For Herodikos Plus, this includes the following ICD-10 code groups: M54.X, F45.40, M25.36, M25.56, M25.96, M17.X, M22.X, M23.X, and S83.X.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of all adult patients who participated in the Herodikos Plus or OrthoHeroBKK care programmes between March 2024 and July 2026 due to an ICD-10 diagnosis affecting the back, knee, or cervical spine. The two care programmes will be analysed separately without direct comparison.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Participation in Herodikos Plus or OrthoHeroBKK between March 2024 and July 2026
Presence of a diagnosis eligible for the respective care programme:
OrthoHeroBKK: M54.2, M54.3, M54.4, M54.5, M54.6, M25.26, M25.36, M25.66, M25.56, M17.0 to M17.9, M22.0, M22.1, M22.2, M22.3, M22.4, M23.2, M23.33, M23.5, M23.6, M23.8, or M23.9
Herodikos Plus: M54.X, F45.40, M25.36, M25.56, M25.96, M17.X, M22.X, M23.X, or S83.X
Documented baseline pain intensity greater than 0 on the Numerical Rating Scale
Completion of at least one documented exercise or training session
Availability of the routine-care data required for the respective analysis
Exclusion criteria:
Age under 18 years
No participation in either care programme during the defined study period
No diagnosis eligible for the respective programme
Missing baseline pain score or baseline pain score of 0
No documented exercise or training session
Missing, implausible, or non-evaluable data for the respective endpoint
Objection to data processing, valid withdrawal of consent, or an existing request for data deletion
Duplicate records, test records, or technically invalid records that cannot be assigned to routine care
